payload.summary: Planning and test authoring completed for PiRunner re-audit sprint. Identified critical workflow state machine blocker preventing automatic roster handoff. Sprint paused pending blocker resolution.

accomplishments.description: Produced KnowledgeSnapshot verifying repository state at HEAD 293ef0f. All 53 tests passing, working tree clean, dependency lock unchanged.
Decomposed re-audit work into 14 tasks across 3 phases: TECHSPEC synchronization (T1-T6), TestSpecification authority fix (T7-T12), and commit/dogfood (T13-T14). Estimated 1 day effort.
Derived acceptance tests from SprintSpecification. Added 2 automated tests for TestSpecification authority (55 total, 16 files). All tests passing.

decisions.decision: Sprint scope limited to normative reconciliation and targeted fixes
decisions.rationale: Reviewer identified specific defects requiring resolution; architectural redesign not needed
decisions.impact: Focused 1-day sprint with clear completion criteria

decisions.decision: TestSpecification authority as primary code change
decisions.rationale: Generic workflow correctness defect identified by reviewer; affects all future test specifications
decisions.impact: Ensures framework/command/roots/hash are consistently sourced from accepted TestSpecification

decisions.decision: Pause dogfooding due to workflow state machine blocker
decisions.rationale: PiRunner doesn't automatically handle roster handoff between roles; manual state management observed
decisions.impact: Dogfooding cannot validate core workflow mechanism until blocker resolved

blockers.blocker: Workflow state machine doesn't drive automatic role transitions
blockers.description: Role transitions require manual state management rather than deterministic, artifact-driven transitions. Roster handoff not working as specified.
blockers.nextSteps: Plan separate sprint to fix workflow state machine before resuming dogfooding

payload.notes: Day concluded with role transition to DEVLOG. Sprint paused pending resolution of workflow state machine blocker. All planning and test authoring artifacts complete and accepted.
